title: Nutty Tender Greek Pistachio Soup
description: A creamy, nutty Greek-inspired soup thats gentle on hangover throats, uses lard for depth, and stays low-sodiumfriendly.
instructions: Toast the pistachios in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 3‑4 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In a large pot, melt the lard over medium heat. Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery; sauté until the vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, oregano, and thyme; cook for another 30 seconds until aromatic.
Pour in the low‑sodium vegetable broth and tomato puree, stir to combine, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the soup simmer for 15 minutes to meld flavors.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth and tender. If you don’t have an immersion blender, transfer in batches to a countertop blender.
Stir in the toasted pistachios and lemon juice; heat through for 2 minutes to coat.
Taste and adjust seasoning with a pinch of salt if desired (optional due to low sodium). Ladle the soup into bowls.
Garnish each bowl with chopped fresh parsley and a few drops of lard for extra richness. Serve hot.
